about: Articles to read later. In Safari, press Share, choose Routine Run, then To read, and each link becomes a step that opens it. Read them in any order: Now brings one forward, and Skip lets one go.
name: To read

steps.about: Anywhere there is a Share button: press it, choose Routine Run, then To read. It arrives as a step, after whatever is waiting. Press Next when you have tried it.
steps.title: Send the first one here
